security_audit.summary: Most static command execution detections are false positives caused by JavaScript template literals and Markdown file references. The remaining concern is privacy handling in telemetry examples that collect user, request, and runtime context.

remediation.issue: Telemetry examples collect user and request context.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit data minimization guidance, field allowlists, and consent checks before sending user or request data to monitoring services.

remediation.issue: The sample redaction list is narrow.
remediation.suggestion: Expand redaction to cover authorization headers, cookies, session identifiers, emails, phone numbers, and other personal data.
Document that endpoints must be trusted, encrypted, and owned by the organization or approved monitoring provider.

content.value_statement: Production errors are hard to triage when logs, alerts, and dashboards are incomplete. This skill provides practical patterns for tracking errors, grouping events, and improving response workflows.
actual_capabilities: Reviews current error handling and monitoring coverage.
Designs error tracking integrations for services such as Sentry.
Provides structured logging patterns with context and audit events.
Defines alert rules, thresholds, and escalation workflows.
Outlines dashboard views for error rates, trends, and live streams.
Suggests grouping, recovery, and troubleshooting documentation.
limitations: Requires project details to tailor monitoring recommendations.
Does not operate a monitoring service or store telemetry.
Sample integrations must be adapted for each stack and compliance model.
Privacy controls need review before production deployment.

use_cases.title: Prepare Production Error Monitoring
use_cases.description: Set up tracking, logs, alerts, and dashboards before launching a service.

use_cases.title: Improve Incident Triage
use_cases.description: Create clearer error grouping, severity rules, and escalation paths for active systems.

use_cases.title: Standardize Observability Guidance
use_cases.description: Document monitoring patterns that teams can reuse across services.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Error Coverage
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit for an existing project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my error tracking setup. Identify missing logging, alerting, grouping, and dashboard coverage. Ask for details you need first.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Monitoring Rollout
prompt_templates.scenario: Implementation plan for a service team.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an error monitoring rollout plan for this stack. Include integration steps, alert rules, dashboard metrics, and verification checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design Alert Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Design alert rules for production errors. Include severity levels, thresholds, deduplication, escalation, and noise reduction guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Build Full Diagnostics Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a complete diagnostics workflow. Include structured logs, trace context, error grouping, recovery actions, privacy controls, and runbook outputs.

output_examples.input: Review our Node service error handling and monitoring.
output_examples.output: The response outlines missing global handlers, structured log fields, Sentry setup steps, alert thresholds, and dashboard metrics.

output_examples.input: Create alert rules for high error rates and failed payments.
output_examples.output: The response provides severity levels, rate thresholds, deduplication rules, paging criteria, and follow-up checks for payment incidents.

output_examples.input: Help document our production error response process.
output_examples.output: The response includes a runbook structure, owner assignments, triage steps, rollback criteria, and post-incident review items.

best_practices: Define sensitive data rules before collecting error context.
Group errors by stable fingerprints and actionable ownership.
Test alerts with synthetic failures before relying on them.
anti_patterns: Sending full request bodies or secrets to telemetry providers.
Paging teams for every warning without severity thresholds.
Using dashboards without clear ownership or response actions.

faq.question: Does this skill install an error tracking service?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance and examples for tools your team chooses.

faq.question: Can it work with Sentry?
faq.answer: Yes. The playbook includes Sentry-oriented setup patterns and general monitoring guidance.

faq.question: Does it support structured logging?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers log levels, metadata, transports, request logs, and audit events.

faq.question: Can it help reduce alert noise?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose thresholds, grouping rules, and escalation paths.

faq.question: Is it safe to copy the code samples directly?
faq.answer: Review them first. Adapt credentials, endpoints, privacy controls, and compliance requirements.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
